relations: Descending upper plate reduces the gap to the fixed lower plate, initiating compression of the spiky ball.
Vertical height of the ball shrinks under pressure, causing it to bulge outward laterally beyond the plate edges.
Spiky ridges remain visible on the ball's surface throughout the continuous deformation process.
Descent and deformation slow near the end, leaving a thin compressed layer held between the plates.
caption: The video captures a vertical press assembly centered against a green wall marked with two yellow warning signs. A cylindrical head wrapped in yellow-and-black diagonal stripes sits atop a polished circular metal plate, while a matching lower plate rests on the workbench. Between the plates lies a pink-and-purple spiky ball, its ridged disc shape compressing as the upper assembly descends. As the clip progresses the upper plate moves downward while the lower plate stays fixed, narrowing the gap and squeezing the ball. The ball's height shrinks and it bulges outward, spreading wider than the lower plate's diameter while its spiky ridges remain visible. Near the final frames the descent and deformation slow, leaving the ball as a thin compressed layer still held between the plates.
